title: Senior MLOps Engineer / ML Platform Architect
description: Senior technical leadership position driving enterprise MLOps strategy: Karpenter just-in-time GPU scaling, NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) hardware partitioning, closed-loop Continuous Training (CT) self-healing pipelines, GitOps platform synchronization, and EU AI Act regulatory compliance.

skills.rationale: Architecting event-driven KEDA GPU autoscaling on DCGM metrics and sub-millisecond cold start optimization.
Architecting NVIDIA MIG hardware partitioning, GPU reservation planning, and cutting cloud ML spend.
Establishing enterprise GitOps (Argo CD) for machine learning fleets and multi-region Canary automation.
Architecting Karpenter just-in-time GPU node provisioning and multi-region disaster recovery systems.
Scaling multi-node PyTorchJob distributed training clusters with Volcano gang scheduling.
Architecting Out-of-Distribution (OOD) protection gates and drift-triggered automated self-healing loops.
Leading EU AI Act/GDPR compliance architectures and enterprise model failure post-mortem runbooks.
Governing enterprise multi-tenant feature store topologies and dataset cryptographic immutability.
Automating global Model Registry webhooks and enterprise artifact retention lifecycles.
Optimizing BuildKit wheel compilation and forward CUDA driver compatibility across GPU clusters.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.description: Does not meet the architectural depth, GPU FinOps, or platform leadership required for senior roles.

partially_ready.description: Strong pipeline builder but lacks hardware partitioning (MIG), Karpenter autoscaling, or enterprise MLOps architecture.

ready.description: Proven senior MLOps engineer with comprehensive platform design, GPU FinOps, and production serving mastery.

exceeds.description: Visionary ML platform architect capable of building enterprise-scale, cost-optimized AI infrastructure.
